fullDescription: A whisper-quiet, premium LIGHT contact page for a calm product brand (Quill), built around one signature pairing: a restrained VALUE-PROP / context column on the left beside a compact INLINE form card on the right, the whole page rendered in a strict graphite-monochrome palette with ZERO accent hue (only graphite + a single platinum grey). A sticky blurred paper nav (an ink ph:feather-fill logo tile + a tracking-tightest 'Quill' wordmark, Product/Pricing/Docs/Contact links with Contact at full ink, a 'Sign in' link and an ink rounded-full 'Get in touch' CTA) tops the page over a full-bleed CSS background: a soft platinum grain wash under a hairline grid that fades in only from the top-right corner. THE CONTACT band splits mx-auto max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[1fr_0.92fr]: a LEFT VALUE-PROP column (a 'Contact' eyebrow pill with a platinum dot, a font-bold tracking-tightest 'Tell us what you're building.' headline, a one-line lead, a fading hairline rule, two icon meta rows Email + Response time, and a bottom 'Trusted by makers' trust line) beside a RIGHT compact INLINE FORM card (a rounded-3xl bordered white/85 backdrop-blur card with a 'Send a message' / 'Takes 30 seconds' header, an Email input + a Message textarea using light .field controls that focus to a soft platinum ring + an ink border, a full-width ink 'Send message' button with a paper-plane glyph and a hover lift, and a lock-icon privacy line). Inter throughout (tight, optical-size), Phosphor (ph:) icons, hairline mist borders, and a fading .rule divider. The reusable signature is the GRAPHITE-MONOCHROME INLINE-FORM contact system: a value-prop column beside a compact inline form card, exactly ZERO accent color (emphasis carried by weight + tracking + one platinum grey), and .field inputs that focus to a platinum ring instead of any colored highlight. Mood: quiet, premium, calm, restrained and human, never a loud or colorful SaaS form.

structured.summary: A whisper-quiet, premium LIGHT contact page for a calm product brand (Quill), built around one signature pairing: a restrained VALUE-PROP / context column on the left beside a compact INLINE form card on the right, the whole page rendered in a strict graphite-monochrome palette (no accent hue at all). The page stacks as a sticky blurred paper nav, then THE CONTACT section as a single full-bleed band over a decorative CSS background (a soft radial 'grain' wash + a masked hairline grid fading from the top-right corner), then a thin full-bleed footer rule. THE CONTACT band is split mx-auto max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 -> lg:grid-cols-[1fr_0.92fr] gap-x-16: a LEFT VALUE-PROP column (a 'Contact' eyebrow pill with a platinum dot, a 'Tell us what you're building.' display headline, a one-line reassurance lead, a gradient hairline rule, two restrained icon meta rows Email + Response time in a <dl>, and a bottom 'Trusted by makers' trust line pinned with mt-auto) and a RIGHT INLINE FORM card (a rounded-3xl bordered white/85 backdrop-blur card with a 'Send a message' / 'Takes 30 seconds' header, an Email input + a Message textarea using .field controls that focus to a soft platinum ring + an ink border, a full-width ink 'Send message' button with a paper-plane glyph and a hover lift/shadow, and a lock-icon privacy reassurance line). The reusable signature is the GRAPHITE-MONOCHROME INLINE-FORM contact system: a calm off-white paper canvas, a tight near-black ink type ramp, EXACTLY ZERO accent color (only graphite + platinum greys), a value-prop column beside a compact inline form card, and .field inputs that focus to a platinum ring instead of any colored highlight. Inter throughout (tight, opsz), Phosphor (ph:) icons, mood quiet/premium/calm/human, never a loud colorful SaaS form.

style.description: A whisper-quiet, premium LIGHT aesthetic on an off-white paper canvas (#f7f7f5, with a lighter paper2 #fbfbfa) with a tight near-black ink type ramp and ZERO accent color: the only non-grey is the page itself, the entire palette is graphite monochrome plus a single platinum cool-grey used as the 'accent'. Register a custom Tailwind theme of ink #1c1c1e, graphite #2c2c2e, slate2 #3a3a3c, platinum #c7c7cc, mist #e5e5ea, paper #f7f7f5, paper2 #fbfbfa, and a letterSpacing token tightest = -0.045em. The whole page reads as one quiet near-monochrome surface: ink for headings/primary text + the logo tile + the primary button, slate2 (#3a3a3c) for body + nav links + labels, mist (#e5e5ea) for hairline borders + dividers, platinum (#c7c7cc) for the lone 'accent' dot + the focus ring + the lock glyph. There is no colored highlight anywhere; emphasis comes from weight, tracking and the single platinum grey. The decorative BACKGROUND is CSS-only: a .grain layer (two soft radial-gradients of platinum at low alpha, circle at 18% 22% rgba(199,199,204,.20) transparent 42% + circle at 88% 8% rgba(199,199,204,.16) transparent 38%) plus a .hairline-grid (two crossing linear-gradients of rgba(28,28,30,.05) 1px lines at background-size 52px 52px, masked with a radial-gradient mask-image 120% 110% at 100% 0% so the grid only shows fading from the top-right corner). Form fields are LIGHT inset: a .field with background #ffffff, a 1px #e5e5ea border, a #8b8b92 placeholder, that on :hover lifts the border to platinum #c7c7cc and on :focus drops outline, turns the border ink #1c1c1e and punches a soft 4px platinum ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(199,199,204,.32)), all eased over .18s. The primary button .btn-press has an active translateY(1px) press and on hover deepens ink -> graphite with a soft drop shadow (0 12px 28px -12px rgba(28,28,30,.55)). The sticky nav uses a .nav-blur (backdrop-filter saturate(180%) blur(14px)) over a translucent paper/80 fill. A .rule helper draws a fading hairline (height 1px, linear-gradient transparent -> mist 12% -> mist 88% -> transparent). Type is Inter only (Google Fonts, optical-size axis opsz 14..32, weights 400/500/600/700) mapped to fontFamily.sans, rendered antialiased with font-feature-settings 'cv05','ss01','calt'; the page sets a global tracking-tight and the headline uses the custom tracking-tightest (-0.045em). Corners are soft and premium (rounded-lg on the logo tile, rounded-xl on the meta-row icon tiles + the fields + the button, rounded-3xl on the form card, rounded-full on the eyebrow + nav CTA pills). Mood: quiet, premium, calm, restrained and human, never a loud or colorful SaaS form.

style.fonts: Inter only (Google Fonts, the variable optical-size build family=Inter:opsz,wght@14..32 at weights 400/500/600/700), mapped as Tailwind fontFamily.sans and rendered with -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased, text-rendering:optimizeLegibility and font-feature-settings 'cv05','ss01','calt'. The DISPLAY HEADLINE is the anchor: font-bold (700), the custom tracking-tightest (letter-spacing -0.045em), leading-[1.04], a responsive clamp text-[40px] -> sm:text-[52px] ('Tell us what you're building.' with a hidden-on-mobile <br class='hidden sm:block'> splitting the two lines). Eyebrows and small labels (the 'Contact' pill, the 'Email' / 'Response time' meta labels, the field labels) are UPPERCASE with a wide tracking-[0.16em] at text-[11px]-[11.5px] font-semibold in slate2. The lead line is text-[17px] leading-[1.65] text-slate2; the form-card 'Send a message' heading is text-[15px] font-semibold; field labels are text-[12.5px] font-semibold; field text + inputs are text-[14.5px] text-ink; the submit button is text-[14px] font-semibold; nav links are text-[13.5px] font-medium; the nav CTA is text-[13px] font-semibold; small meta ('Takes 30 seconds', 'Optional context welcome', the privacy + trust + footer lines) are text-[11.5px]-[12.5px]. The whole page carries a global tracking-tight, with the headline tightened further to tracking-tightest. All numerals + UI run in Inter, no second family.
style.palette: paper #f7f7f5 (the page + nav + contact-band background; the nav uses paper/80, sections use paper2 tints), paper2 #fbfbfa (the eyebrow pill fill at /70, the meta-row icon tiles, the footer band at /60), white #ffffff (the form-card fill at /85 with backdrop-blur, the field fill). The text + structure ramp is graphite monochrome: ink #1c1c1e (headings, primary text, the logo tile, the active 'Contact' nav link, the email link, mailto, the primary button + its hover-to-graphite, the focused field border), graphite #2c2c2e (the button hover-deepen target), slate2 #3a3a3c (body + lead copy, nav links, all labels + eyebrow text, meta values' secondary text, the footer + small-print text), mist #e5e5ea (all hairline borders + dividers + the .rule gradient + the field default border #e5e5ea), platinum #c7c7cc (the ONLY 'accent': the eyebrow dot, the field :hover border, the focus ring rgba(199,199,204,.32) and the lock glyph). The placeholder grey is #8b8b92. The hairline-grid lines are rgba(28,28,30,.05) and the grain radials are platinum rgba(199,199,204,.20)/.16. There is NO accent hue at all, no second color, no loud gradient: the only 'gradients' are the CSS grain radials, the masked hairline grid and the box-shadows.

layout_and_structure.description:
A full-bleed light contact page, centered inside a mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 (lg:px-8) container, stacked top to bottom as: (1) a sticky blurred paper nav, (2) THE CONTACT band, a single full-bleed
over a decorative CSS background, and (3) a thin full-bleed footer rule. The defining structural move is THE CONTACT band's restrained two-column split: a grid grid-cols-1 items-stretch gap-x-16 -> lg:grid-cols-[1fr_0.92fr] band pairing a LEFT VALUE-PROP / context column (slightly wider) with a RIGHT compact INLINE FORM card (slightly narrower). The LEFT column is a flex flex-col stacked: an eyebrow pill, a display headline, a one-line lead, a fading .rule, a two-row
of icon meta (Email + Response time), and a bottom trust line pinned to the floor with mt-auto (hidden below lg). The RIGHT column is a single rounded-3xl bordered white/85 backdrop-blur form card: a header row ('Send a message' + 'Takes 30 seconds'), a space-y-5 field stack (Email input + Message textarea), a full-width ink submit button, and a centered lock-icon privacy line. Behind both sits the full-bleed decorative background: an absolute -z-10 .grain wash + an absolute -z-10 .hairline-grid (opacity-70) that only fades in from the top-right corner. Everything reflows to a single column below lg (the form card drops below the value-prop column, gaining mt-12; the LEFT column's bottom trust block, hidden below lg, reappears at lg); the nav center links + Sign in link hide below md/sm; the headline
hides below sm; the meta rows + footer reflow cleanly; no horizontal overflow at 390px.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 <header> with a border-b border-mist/80 bottom hairline and a .nav-blur translucent fill (bg-paper/80, backdrop-filter saturate(180%) blur(14px)). Inner row mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-6xl items-center justify-between px-6 (lg:px-8). LEFT: a logo link (flex items-center gap-2.5 group) = a grid h-8 w-8 place-items-center rounded-lg bg-ink text-paper shadow-sm tile holding a Phosphor 'ph:feather-fill' glyph (text-[17px]) that rotates -6deg on group-hover, beside a text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tightest text-ink 'Quill' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex, gap-9): four nav links 'Product' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' / 'Contact' in text-[13.5px] font-medium text-slate2 hover:text-ink, with the current 'Contact' link set to full text-ink. RIGHT (flex items-center gap-3): a 'Sign in' text link (hidden below sm, text-[13.5px] font-medium text-slate2 hover:text-ink) and a 'Get in touch' primary pill (rounded-full bg-ink px-4 py-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-paper shadow-sm hover:bg-graphite .btn-press).

A <main id='contact'> that is relative isolate overflow-hidden, holding two pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 -z-10 decorative layers: a .grain wash (background-image two radial-gradients of platinum at low alpha: circle at 18% 22% rgba(199,199,204,.20) transparent 42%, circle at 88% 8% rgba(199,199,204,.16) transparent 38%) and a .hairline-grid opacity-70 (background-image two crossing linear-gradients of rgba(28,28,30,.05) 1px lines at background-size 52px 52px, mask-image a radial-gradient 120% 110% at 100% 0% #000 30% transparent 72% so the grid only fades in from the top-right corner). Over these, the content grid: mx-auto grid max-w-6xl grid-cols-1 items-stretch gap-x-16 px-6 py-20 (sm:py-24 lg:grid-cols-[1fr_0.92fr] lg:gap-x-16 lg:px-8 lg:py-28).

The LEFT cell is a <section class='flex flex-col'>. First an EYEBROW PILL: an inline-flex w-max items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-mist bg-paper2/70 px-3 py-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate2 pill reading 'Contact', led by a h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-platinum dot (the lone platinum accent). Then the DISPLAY HEADLINE h1 (mt-7 text-[40px] font-bold leading-[1.04] tracking-tightest text-ink sm:text-[52px]) reading 'Tell us what' + a hidden-on-mobile <br class='hidden sm:block'> + ' you're building.' Then a mt-6 max-w-md text-[17px] leading-[1.65] text-slate2 LEAD line: 'One message, a real reply within a day. No tickets, no queue music, just a person who reads it.' Then a mt-10 .rule max-w-md fading hairline divider.

prompts.prompt: Below the rule, a <dl class='mt-9 max-w-md space-y-5 text-[14.5px] leading-7 text-slate2'> of two META ROWS, each a flex items-start gap-3.5: a leading mt-0.5 grid h-9 w-9 flex-none place-items-center rounded-xl border border-mist bg-paper2 text-ink ICON TILE holding a Phosphor glyph (text-[18px]), beside a <div> of a <dt> (text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate2 label) over a mt-1 <dd>. Row 1 = a 'ph:envelope-simple' tile + a 'Email' label + a 'hello@quill.studio' mailto (font-medium text-ink hover:text-slate2). Row 2 = a 'ph:clock-countdown' tile + a 'Response time' label + a 'Within 24 hours, Mon to Fri' value (font-medium text-ink). Then, pinned to the floor with mt-auto and hidden below lg (mt-auto hidden pt-14 lg:block), a TRUST BLOCK: a .rule mb-6 max-w-md divider over a text-[12.5px] leading-6 text-slate2 line 'Trusted by makers at studios shipping interface work, daily.'

prompts.prompt: The RIGHT cell is a <section class='mt-12 lg:mt-0'> (so it drops below the value-prop column with extra top margin on mobile, then sits beside it at lg). Inside, a single <form> CARD: rounded-3xl border border-mist bg-white/85 p-7 (sm:p-9) backdrop-blur-sm, carrying a layered shadow (an inset top highlight 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) plus a soft drop 0 24px 60px -32px rgba(28,28,30,.35)). Top: a mb-7 flex items-center justify-between HEADER with a text-[15px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-ink 'Send a message' heading and a text-[12px] font-medium text-slate2 'Takes 30 seconds' note.

Inside the form card, a space-y-5 FIELD STACK of two groups. Group 1 (Email): a mb-2 block text-[12.5px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate2 'Email' label over an <input type=email autocomplete=email placeholder='you@studio.com'> styled .field block w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[14.5px] text-ink. Group 2 (Message): a mb-2 flex items-center justify-between header pairing a text-[12.5px] font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate2 'Message' label with a text-[11.5px] text-slate2 'Optional context welcome' note, over a <textarea rows=5 placeholder='A line on what you're working on, and how we can help.'> styled .field block w-full resize-none rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-[14.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink. Each .field = background #ffffff + 1px #e5e5ea border + #8b8b92 placeholder, that on :hover raises the border to platinum #c7c7cc and on :focus drops outline, turns the border ink #1c1c1e and adds a 4px platinum ring (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(199,199,204,.32)), eased .18s.

Below it, a mt-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-center text-[12px] text-slate2 PRIVACY line led by a text-platinum 'ph:lock-simple' glyph (text-[13px]): 'We reply from a real inbox. Never shared, never spammed.'

After the content grid (still inside <main>), a full-bleed FOOTER band: a border-t border-mist/80 bg-paper2/60 strip with an inner mx-auto flex max-w-6xl flex-col items-center justify-between gap-3 px-6 py-6 text-[12.5px] text-slate2 (sm:flex-row lg:px-8). LEFT: a '(c) 2026 Quill Studio' note. RIGHT: a flex items-center gap-6 of three links 'Privacy' / 'Status' / '@quill' (font-medium hover:text-ink). Below sm the footer goes flex-col items-center.

Ink primary button with a press + hover lift: a full-width .btn-press rounded-xl bg-ink text-paper 'Send message' button with a trailing 'ph:paper-plane-tilt-fill' glyph that nudges on group-hover, that on :hover deepens bg-ink -> bg-graphite with a soft drop shadow (0 12px 28px -12px rgba(28,28,30,.55)) and on :active presses down translateY(1px).

Compact inline form card: a rounded-3xl border border-mist bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-sm p-7 (sm:p-9) card with a layered shadow (an inset top highlight 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7) + a soft drop 0 24px 60px -32px rgba(28,28,30,.35)), holding a 'Send a message' / 'Takes 30 seconds' header, a space-y-5 Email + Message field stack, an ink submit button and a lock-icon privacy line.

Restrained icon meta rows: a <dl> of two flex items-start gap-3.5 rows, each a rounded-xl border border-mist bg-paper2 h-9 w-9 icon tile (a Phosphor 'ph:envelope-simple' / 'ph:clock-countdown' glyph) beside an uppercase tracking-[0.16em] <dt> label over a font-medium ink <dd> value (a 'hello@quill.studio' mailto + a 'Within 24 hours, Mon to Fri' line).

Eyebrow pill with the lone platinum dot: an inline-flex w-max rounded-full border border-mist bg-paper2/70 px-3 py-1 text-[11.5px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-slate2 pill reading 'Contact', led by a h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-platinum dot, the single spot of the platinum 'accent'.

Fading .rule hairline divider: a height:1px helper drawn as a linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #e5e5ea 12%, #e5e5ea 88%, transparent), used max-w-md under the lead and above the trust line so dividers fade out at both ends instead of hard mist edges.

Sticky blurred paper nav: a sticky top-0 z-50 border-b border-mist/80 .nav-blur (backdrop-filter saturate(180%) blur(14px)) bar over bg-paper/80, with an ink 'ph:feather-fill' logo tile (rotating -6deg on hover) + a tracking-tightest 'Quill' wordmark, four md:flex Product/Pricing/Docs/Contact links with Contact at full ink, a Sign in link and an ink rounded-full 'Get in touch' CTA.

splitting the two lines, the page's anchor element in tight Inter.
